headline: INTC Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center and AI Strength Offset Market Concerns Amid Supply Constraints
summary: Computer processor maker Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 25.4% year on year to $16.13 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($16.3 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 7.8% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.42 per share was 93.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
